other_conditions: Applicant must be an individual, group of individuals, association, or organization representing the Brahmin community.
The society/trust must prepare cost estimates for construction projects or a detailed project report for socially relevant activities.
The society/trust must open a separate bank account and deposit 50% of the estimated project cost.
benefits_summary: Provides matching funds that double the applicant's contribution to create permanent community assets and support education, skill development, entrepreneurship, healthcare, and welfare projects for the Brahmin community.
